name: NeuroAI and Machine Learning in Neuroscience
description:
Advanced programming in Python and Brian.
The concept and implementation of:
Dendritic models and biologically plausible back propagation.
Network models – mean-field models, Fokker Planck formalism, linear response theory.
Plasticity and Learning – Hawkes processes, separation of timescales.
Efficient coding theory – Emergence of receptive field properties, quantifying information in neural data.
NeuroAI – Training RNNs and SNNs, reinforcement learning, hierarchical models, predictive coding, machine learningtools for neuroscience.
prerequisites: Basic knowledge in calculus (MA9411, MA9412 or equivalent) and in linear algebra (MA9409 or equivalent) isrequired. Basic knowledge in dynamical systems (EI00450, EI00220 or equivalent), programming (IN8026 orequivalent) and neuroscience/neurophysiology is recommended. Students should also be familiar with topics in Computational Neuroscience (e.g. LS20007) or Machine Learning.
